propositions: A single mapped project's base-query transport failure (ACLI 4xx/5xx, timeout, rate-limit) currently aborts the entire reconciliation pass for all projects in _build_snapshot's flat queries loop.

The base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation that the enrichment loop (_enrich_project) already provides; a nonexistent project key can take down 12+ hours of scheduled passes across all projects.

_fetch_project helper must drain both active and done-recent queries for one project into a local dict and merge only on success, ensuring no partial keys leak to the shared snapshot as false deletions.

Per-project transport errors must emit a fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert (naming project and pass_id) and continue, while BackendPaginationStallError and syntactically-invalid keys still fail the pass.
The single-project path and dedup behavior must remain unchanged; per-project error handling must be atomic at merge boundary.
